_comments.description: LINE QA Assistant — RAG workflow: LINE Webhook → signature verify → allowed_users auth → vector search → Ollama Qwen2.5 → LINE reply → session update → qa_log

required_env_vars.PROJECT_ROOT: Absolute path to project root, e.g. D:/n8n/CLAUDE 實做/本地AI企業問答助理
required_env_vars.LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN: From LINE Developers Console → Messaging API → Channel access token
required_env_vars.LINE_CHANNEL_SECRET: From LINE Developers Console → Basic settings → Channel secret

_comments.api_server_setup: REQUIRED: start the local API server before activating this workflow: python scripts/api_server.py  (default port 8765). This server wraps line_verify.py, vector_search.py, prompt_builder.py as HTTP endpoints — replaces executeCommand nodes which are removed in n8n 2.12+.
_comments.credential_setup: Create a PostgreSQL credential in n8n named 'PostgreSQL - vectordb': host=localhost, port=65432, db=vectordb, user=testuser, password=testpwd. Update credential ID in all Postgres nodes (currently set to placeholder 'POSTGRES_CRED_ID').
_comments.webhook_url: After import, activate workflow. Webhook URL: https://<your-n8n-domain>/webhook/line-qa — register this in LINE Developers Console as Webhook URL.
_comments.rawbody_note: Webhook node requires 'Raw Body' option enabled so $json.rawBody contains the exact bytes LINE signed. Headers must include x-line-signature (available automatically via $json.headers in n8n v1.x).
_comments.error_handler_note: Error Trigger fires when any node throws. It cannot send a LINE reply (replyToken unavailable in error context) but logs to processing_logs. Set this workflow as its own errorWorkflow in n8n Workflow Settings.

nodes.name: LINE Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives LINE Webhook POST. responseMode=onReceived returns HTTP 200 immediately (LINE requires 200 within 1s). rawBody=true stores raw bytes as $json.rawBody for HMAC-SHA256 signature verification. Signature is in $json.headers['x-line-signature'].

nodes.name: Execute: line_verify
nodes.notes: POST to local api_server.py /line-verify. Sends {body, signature}. Returns {valid: bool}. api_server.py must be running: python scripts/api_server.py

nodes.name: Parse Verify
nodes.notes: Returns null (drops item) if signature is invalid or line_verify.py failed. Returning null stops the workflow naturally; n8n already replied HTTP 200 to LINE.

nodes.name: Parse Message
nodes.notes: Extracts lineUserId, messageText, replyToken from events[0]. Returns null for non-text events or empty events array (LINE webhook verification). Only processes text message events.

nodes.name: Execute: vector_search
nodes.notes: POST to local api_server.py /vector-search. Returns JSON array [{chunk_id, chunk_text, file_name, similarity}] or [] on error. continueOnFail=true for graceful degradation.

nodes.name: Parse Chunks
nodes.notes: Parses vector_search.py JSON output. Gracefully degrades to empty chunks if vector_search failed. Carries lineUserId/messageText/replyToken from Parse Message for later nodes.

nodes.name: Query conversation_sessions

parameters.query: ={{ `SELECT COALESCE((SELECT turns FROM conversation_sessions WHERE line_user_id = '${$json.lineUserId}' LIMIT 1), '[]'::jsonb) AS turns` }}

nodes.notes: Always returns exactly 1 row using COALESCE. Returns existing turns or '[]' if no session yet. This guarantees downstream nodes always receive 1 item (empty turns array for new users).

nodes.name: Query allowed_users

parameters.query: ={{ `SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM allowed_users WHERE line_user_id = '${$('Parse Chunks').first().json.lineUserId}') AS authorized` }}

nodes.notes: Always returns exactly 1 row with {authorized: true/false}. Uses EXISTS so 0 or 1 match gives boolean result — ensures Check Auth always executes regardless of whitelist membership.

nodes.name: Check Auth
nodes.notes: Checks allowed_users whitelist. If unauthorized: sends LINE reply '您無使用權限' via $helpers.httpRequest, returns null to stop workflow. If authorized: merges chunks+history, writes prompt_builder input to temp file (_tmp_prompt path stored in output JSON).

nodes.name: Execute: prompt_builder
nodes.notes: POST to local api_server.py /prompt-builder. Sends {question, chunks, history}. Returns {system, prompt}.

nodes.name: Parse Prompt
nodes.notes: Deletes temp file, parses prompt_builder.py output. Throws on failure (triggers Error Trigger). Carries systemPrompt and userPrompt forward for Ollama node.

nodes.name: Ollama Chat

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({model: 'qwen2.5:7b-instruct-q4_0', messages: [{role: 'system', content: $json.systemPrompt}, {role: 'user', content: $json.userPrompt}], stream: false}) }}

nodes.notes: POST to Ollama /api/chat with model=qwen2.5, stream=false. Timeout 120s for long LLM inference. Response: {model, message: {role, content}, done: true, ...}. Uses OLLAMA_BASE_URL and OLLAMA_CHAT_MODEL env vars.

nodes.name: Extract Answer
nodes.notes: Extracts answer from Ollama response.message.content (api/chat) or response.response (api/generate). Falls back to hardcoded message if empty.

nodes.name: LINE Reply
nodes.notes: POST to LINE Reply API with replyToken and answer text. Authorization: Bearer {LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN}. replyToken expires after ~1 minute of the original event.

nodes.name: Post-Reply Processing
nodes.notes: Prepares data for both PostgreSQL updates: (1) newTurnsJson = JSON string of updated conversation turns trimmed to 10 turns (5 rounds); (2) chunkIdsArray = PostgreSQL array literal string '{uuid1,uuid2}' for ::uuid[] cast in qa_logs INSERT.

nodes.name: Update conversation_sessions

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO conversation_sessions (line_user_id, turns)
VALUES ($1, $2::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (line_user_id)
DO UPDATE SET turns = EXCLUDED.turns, updated_at = NOW()

nodes.notes: UPSERT conversation session. $2 is newTurnsJson (JSON string of turns array), cast to jsonb in SQL. continueOnFail=true so qa_logs INSERT is not blocked by session update failure.

nodes.name: Insert qa_logs

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO qa_logs (user_id, question, retrieved_chunk_ids, answer)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3::uuid[], $4)

nodes.notes: Inserts QA log. $3 is chunkIdsArray formatted as '{uuid1,uuid2}' PostgreSQL array literal, cast to uuid[] in SQL. continueOnFail=true so a log insert failure does not surface as workflow error.

nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires when any node in this workflow throws an unhandled error. Receives execution context: $json.execution.error.message, $json.execution.lastNodeExecuted, $json.workflow.id. Cannot send LINE reply (replyToken unavailable) — logs error to processing_logs only.

nodes.name: Log Error

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO processing_logs (file_name, step_name, log_level, message, details)
VALUES ('LINE QA', $1, 'error', $2, $3::jsonb)

nodes.notes: Logs workflow error to processing_logs. step_name = lastNodeExecuted, message = error message, details = full error JSON. To also send LINE error reply, you would need to store replyToken in n8n workflow static data at an early stage.
